text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S.: Syria talks still on hold.
- Inquiry into helicopter crash will investigate suspicion of negligence.
- January cost of living index rose 0.4 percent; February salaries include supplement of 0.65 percent.
- Officials in U.S. administration: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ready for a territorial compromise on Golan Heights.
- Warning letters expected to be sent to the commander of the air squadron and his two deputies in the helicopter crash.
- Worry in air force at seriousness of the failures uncovered by the helicopter inquiry.
- One-day rail strike by workers opposed to break-up.
